_comment_variant: HYDRA Variant C — Brandon Trojan Horse stack with Brandon's narrow 5/10pt spread widths (his actual rule from the interview). Identical Brandon feature stack AND identical narrow_spread widths to variant B (both: 5pt at VIX < 22, 10pt at VIX >= 22). B and C do NOT differ on spread width. The real differences are: a sparser 3-slot morning grid (10:15/10:45/11:15 vs B's 7-slot 09:45-12:45 grid) and a tighter concurrency cap (vix_regime.max_entries [2,2,2,1] vs B's [7,7,7,7]). CURRENT STATE (since the 2026-07-24 live-seat swap, RUNBOOKS.md RB-9): C is dry-run-shadow at 7 contracts (alerts + Sheets logging off so it doesn't pollute the canonical record); B is now the LIVE paper seat. C was live (7c) from its original go-live through 2026-07-24. NOTE: this checked-in file is a sample/template, not deploy-authoritative — the VM's live copy is edited directly there (see CLAUDE.md Config Files) and may diverge from this value.

strategy._comment_commission: IBKR all-in SPX cost ~$1.15/leg/contract (~$0.65 IBKR Pro base + ~$0.45 CBOE index fee + ~$0.05 ORF/OCC/CAT) — replaces the Saxo-era $2.50 default. Display/reported-P&L only; does NOT affect entry/stop logic. Critical for C: at 10c × 4 legs × 3 slots, the Saxo-vs-IBKR gap is ~$170-340/day — judging C's dry-run at $2.50 would wrongly book phantom fees. Set 2026-05-29 at the IBKR cutover.
strategy._comment_widths: MKT-027 settings here are unused at runtime — strategy.brandon.narrow_spread.enabled=true overrides _get_vix_adjusted_spread_width with Brandon's 5/10pt rule. Values kept aligned with variant A's VM config (max=75pt) for consistency / debugging clarity.
strategy._comment_put_only_max_vix: Lifted from HYDRA-baseline 15 → 28 because Brandon GEX-ADJ skip-and-route-as-put-only is a core part of his strategy when SPX is inside the call accel zone — capping the fallback at VIX < 15 would block it on most days (VIX 15-25 is normal, not extreme).
strategy._comment_credit_floors: Lowered ~10× vs variants A/B because narrow_spread.enabled=true makes the IC 5pt or 10pt wide instead of 75pt — credits scale roughly proportionally with spread width, so HYDRA's standard $0.20/$0.30 floors would skip every entry.
strategy._comment_safety_caps: ORDER-006 caps raised vs 1c default (10 / 30) to accommodate Brandon narrow-spread sizing. Re-sized 15c -> 10c -> 7c across 2026-05-13 and the 2026-07-24 live-seat swap. Worst-case open contracts on SPX is bounded by vix_regime.max_entries (peak 2, below) not by entry_times count: 7c x 2 concurrent ICs x 4 legs = 56 counted contracts (_get_current_position_size adds contracts_per_entry per open leg; one full IC = 28). The 180 per-underlying cap is intentionally looser than B's 600 — B (7-slot grid + overlays counted) needs the larger ceiling; C (max_entries peak 2, overlays currently off) has ample headroom above its lower contract count. 15 per-order cap leaves headroom for size adjustments without disabling the bug-protection check entirely.
strategy._comment_min_bp_per_ic: ORDER-004 BP-per-contract floor lowered $5000 → $500 because narrow 5pt × $100 = $500/contract margin (Brandon narrow-spread economics). Default is sized for wide HYDRA-baseline; without this override, every entry trips required vs available — same bug pattern as MAX_CONTRACTS_PER_ORDER yesterday.
strategy._comment_pnl_bounds: DATA-003 sanity bounds scaled for narrow-spread x 7c (re-sized from 10c at the 2026-07-24 live-seat swap, itself cut from 15c on 2026-05-13). Multiplied by contracts at runtime: max_pnl_per_ic 100 x 7c = $700 ceiling, min_pnl_per_ic -1000 x 7c = -$7,000 floor. Default -3000 floor would falsely flag real drawdowns as 'impossible' and skip stop checks.
strategy._comment_downday_callonly: OFF on C — Brandon GEX adjuster is the sole side-selection logic on the Brandon stack; HYDRA's down-day call-only override would conflict with GEX zone reads.
strategy._comment_e6_removed_AUD2-M5: Variant C used to declare conditional_entry_times: ['14:00'] but every conditional_*_e6_enabled flag was false. AUD2-M5 (2026-05-24) audit found this inconsistency — the 14:00 slot was being consumed by vix_regime.max_entries cap accounting without ever firing. Removed for clarity. C is now a strict 3-slot morning grid (10:15 / 10:45 / 11:15) — Brandon-faithful baseline.
strategy._comment_conditional_directional: OFF on C — directional bias (down-day put-only at 14:00 / up-day put-only at 14:00) is HYDRA's heuristic. Brandon GEX adjuster already makes the side-selection call from gamma zones; layering both produces conflicting signals on mixed days.
strategy._comment_mkt046: 2026-08-28: same disable as B (see config_variant_b.json's comment + bots/hydra/__init__.py version history for the full study) -- C's own history independently showed the identical result (6/6 delayed stops worse, 0 better, $718.55 additional cost). C is dry-run-shadow, zero real-money risk either way.

vix_regime._comment_min_credits: Per-VIX-zone credit gates also lowered ~10× because narrow 5/10pt spreads collect $0.05-$0.20 typical at 8-delta vs A/B's $1.00-$2.00 on 75pt-wide spreads. Without this scaling, MKT-011 skips every C entry by design (verified live 2026-05-05 10:45: C reported call $0.08 / put $0.02 vs A/B's $1.15 / $1.23 on the same chain).

directional_pivot._comment: Disabled in variant C — Brandon GEX-breach exit (shadow) plays the same role.

brandon._comment: Identical Brandon stack to variant B, INCLUDING narrow_spread (both variants set enabled=true, breakpoint_vix=22.0, width_low=5, width_high=10 — they do NOT differ on spread width). Per Brandon: 5pt at VIX < 22, 10pt at VIX >= 22 (plus a 25pt safety ceiling). All Brandon features are fully LIVE (TP / strike adjuster / breach exit / overlay). Only shadow behavior is hydra_stop_shadow — same as variant B. B vs C differs only at the top-level config (entry_times, vix_regime.max_entries, max_contracts_per_underlying), not inside this brandon block.
brandon._comment_disable_tightening: Same rationale as variant B: HYDRA's MKT-020/MKT-022 tighteners chase credit by walking strikes toward ATM, which clashes with Brandon's GEX-zone strike selection. C's E#2 on 2026-05-07 was tightened from 125pt OTM to 25pt OTM (P:7340) right on the 7330 wall — when the wall broke, the breach close cost was $2,925 vs the recorded $0. Disabled here so Brandon GEX-ADJ is the sole strike-selection mechanism.
brandon._comment_delta_target: Same Brandon-faithful delta-target strike selection as variant B. 8δ short anchored to Polygon's option chain (strategy.target_delta=8 above), with Brandon GEX-ADJ stacked on top to skip accel-zone sides.

gex._comment_accel_peak_locality_pts: 2026-09-05: made EXPLICIT at its existing code-default value (25.0) — no behavior change. The 2026-09-04 gate audit found this threshold set in NEITHER B's nor C's config, so live trading was running an untuned default that was asserted on 2026-05-13 and never derived from data. It is load-bearing: it is the sole mitigation for the hemisphere collapse the module's inverted-vs-SpotGamma sign convention causes (see gex_provider.py's SIGN CONVENTION docstring), and it is what stops every call short — which by definition sits above spot — from landing inside the call-wing 'accel' cluster and being SKIP'd. Surfacing it here so a future retune is a config change with a visible current value, not an invisible code default. Calibration data is now being recorded to the gex_decisions table.
gex._comment_advisory: 2026-06-10: demote GEX-breach to advisory (logs would-close, does NOT act). Research: 70-86% false. credit+buffer (L-C2) is the acting primary.
gex._comment_persistence: 2026-08-12: require 2 independent GEX reads to agree before an accel-zone SKIP fires (Aug 10-12 3-day zero-entry streak fix). C-first observation trial before considering B. See bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.

defensive_overlay._comment_trigger_distance_pts: 2026-08-19: tightened 25 -> 15 after a 9-event replay found 25pt arms the hedge well before real danger on a 5-10pt-wide B/C spread (0/9 events defended a side that was ever actually breached; the 3 realized-loss events all fired 11:02-11:16 ET on threats that evaporated). 15pt sits near a ~2.5-3x multiple of the narrow-spread width (matching this codebase's own OTM-multiplier convention) while staying above the just-tightened 10pt MKT-047 flatten cushion. Confidence is LOW-MEDIUM -- the 9-event sample reduces to ~5-6 independent moments (B/C fired on several identical underlying ticks in parallel) and the 3 known real stop-loss-breach days have zero recoverable hedge data, so this is a monitored/instrumented change, not a settled number. Distance-at-tick logging added alongside this change so a future replay has real data instead of inferred bounds. See bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.
defensive_overlay._comment_reenabled: RE-ENABLED 2026-07-22: sizing fix (quantity-aware place + atomic unwind + longs-first + cap counts overlays) deployed; this is the full Brandon strategy
defensive_overlay._comment_confirm_staging: 2026-08-25: C-first staged trial (dry-run, no real orders) of both new hedge-arming mechanisms before considering a B promotion -- (1) a 10s confirmation delay before the hedge actually places (mirrors _brandon_check_pctwidth_shadow_stop's confirm-then-fire pattern), with a 5pt severity-bypass band so a genuinely fast, severe threat still hedges immediately; (2) use_adjuster_gex_gate=true reuses the strike adjuster's own already-tuned accel_min_pct/accel_peak_locality_pts/accel_peak_persistence_enabled (see the gex block above) for the hedge's own GEX-confirmation check instead of the original hardcoded flat 0.05-with-no-locality-gate check -- the audit found that missing locality gate is the likely reason the hedge's GEX confirmation was close to a rubber stamp. Watch BRANDON-OVERLAY-ARM-PENDING/CONFIRMED/SEVERITY-BYPASS and the gex_confirmed field in BRANDON-OVERLAY-WATCH lines. See bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.
defensive_overlay._comment_debit_spread_disabled: 2026-08-25: disabled in lockstep with B (same evidence, same rationale). Full sourcing: docs/postmortems/2026-08-25_brandon_hedge_pnl_reconstruction.md. The afternoon butterfly stays enabled and continues to run inside this file's separate confirm_seconds/use_adjuster_gex_gate staged trial above. See also bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.

hydra_stop_shadow._comment: When true, computes HYDRA's existing credit+buffer stop every tick in parallel without acting. First fire per side per day is Telegrammed for head-to-head comparison against Brandon's GEX breach (which IS the live stop in B/C).

eod_flatten._comment_skip_otm_pts: 2026-08-18: skip_otm_pts lowered 20 -> 10 after a 19-event MKT-047 historical audit (all variants, back to the mechanism's 2026-06-17 birth) found a 0/19 win rate flattening vs just holding to expiry (net cost ~$805 in the recoverable window) and a real-money 0-for-2 on 2026-08-17 (B lost $175 flattening two puts that both settled OTM). A 15/10/5pt sensitivity re-check on the same 19 events found 10pt recovers ~52% of the historical gap while still protecting the one 2026-08-17 trade that came within 0.36pt of the strike at settlement (E4) -- 15pt changes nothing on that trade, 5pt would have let it ride. See bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.

external_price_feed._comment: Yahoo Finance fallback for VIX/SPX (shared/external_price_feed.py). shared/config_loader.py defaults enabled=false in cloud/LIVE. HYDRA's own VIX read goes through self.broker.get_vix_price() -> IBClient.get_vix_price and does NOT consume this key — the external_price_feed feed is only wired into the shared/apollo path (services/apollo/market_data.py), so this flag has no effect on HYDRA's spread-width / vix_regime math today. (The old Saxo 'NoAccess' / FullTradingAndChat-contention rationale is obsolete post-IBKR cutover.)
